blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine inflation surged back to a three-year high of 7.2 percent in September as adverse weather and rising global oil prices fueled increases in food, utility and transport costs. The latest print, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority, blew past the 6.1-percent rate logged in August, snapping four consecutive months of easing. READ: […]...
